camera_optical.description: front camera image/depth frame: x right, y down, z forward (ROS optical)

camera.description: front camera mount, d435_link: x along the optical axis, y left, z up

left_palm.description: palm link origin (palm base); x toward the fingertips, the fingers curl toward -y

left_index_tip.description: fingertip: the collision vertex farthest from the finger's last joint (geometric, not a contact sensor)

left_middle_tip.description: fingertip: the collision vertex farthest from the finger's last joint (geometric, not a contact sensor)

left_thumb_tip.description: fingertip: the collision vertex farthest from the finger's last joint (geometric, not a contact sensor)

left_hand_center.description: between the open fingers and the thumb: midpoint of the index/middle distal centroid and the thumb distal centroid at zero finger angles

left_sole_center.description: centre of the lowest collision face of the foot

right_palm.description: palm link origin (palm base); x toward the fingertips, the fingers curl toward +y

right_index_tip.description: fingertip: the collision vertex farthest from the finger's last joint (geometric, not a contact sensor)

right_middle_tip.description: fingertip: the collision vertex farthest from the finger's last joint (geometric, not a contact sensor)

right_thumb_tip.description: fingertip: the collision vertex farthest from the finger's last joint (geometric, not a contact sensor)

right_hand_center.description: between the open fingers and the thumb: midpoint of the index/middle distal centroid and the thumb distal centroid at zero finger angles

right_sole_center.description: centre of the lowest collision face of the foot

head_center.description: centre of the head collision bounding box

camera.depth: distance to the image plane (optical z), metres; NaN invalid

frames.camera: d435_link: x optical axis, y left, z up
frames.camera_optical: x right, y down, z forward

hand.command: binary per hand (semantic40 dims 38/39): open = every finger joint 0; closed = the fixed closing pose below. There is no partial or per-finger command. Fingers stop where they meet an object; the PD drives keep pushing toward the target.
hand.joint_order: per hand: thumb_0, thumb_1, thumb_2, middle_0, middle_1, index_0, index_1 (proprio.hand_state uses this order, left hand first)
hand.note: A closed hand is a fist: thumb, index and middle all fold to the targets. Grip comes from where the object sits in the closing fingers; use fingertips_in_palm_frame_m and the stick figure to place the object between the thumb and the two fingers before closing. proprio.hand_state shows where each finger actually stopped.
